entities.name: Vopiscus Julius Iulus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vopiscus Julius Iullus was a Roman statesman, who held the consulship in 473 BC, a year in which the authority of the Roman magistrates was threatened after the murder of a tribune of the plebs.
